messages:
claire: Quick design review re: rotate flow prototypes. Two main asks from PM: in-place rotate (keep key id) vs generate-new (new id). Need clear affordances and copy because secrets are shown only once.
omar: Agree. In-place rotate is useful for CI where key id is referenced in many places. UX question: should we surface a 5 minute "grace period" where the old key still works for in-flight requests? Backend team suggested 5m window. We need to communicate that.
jess: Copy idea for modal header: 'Rotate key (in-place)'. Body: 'This will replace the secret for key <KEY_NAME>. The key id and permissions stay the same. The previous secret will continue to work for 5 minutes to allow in-flight requests. You will only be shown the new secret once 6 you must store it now.' Primary CTA: 'Rotate and copy secret'. Secondary: 'Cancel'.
ryan: Implementation notes: the UI should show a masked preview like "•••••••••••xYz" so users can identify the new key without revealing it. Add a small "Show secret" button that reveals for the current session and is focusable. When revealed, announce via aria-live: 'Secret revealed. Press Ctrl+C to copy.' Also provide a one-click copy button with accessible label 'Copy secret to clipboard'.
claire: Microcopy nit: avoid using the word 'permanent' in rotate flows. Use 'irreversible' only when the secret cannot be recovered. For rotate: 'previous secret will expire after 5 minutes' is clearer.
omar: Ephemeral keys: we should unify create modal: radio selector for 'Long-lived', 'Ephemeral (1h)', and 'Ephemeral (24h)'. When user selects ephemeral, show inline help: 'Ephemeral keys are shown once and auto-expire. Good for short-lived jobs.' CTA for ephemeral should be 'Create ephemeral key' and the success drawer should emphasize copy & download.
jess: Security/perms: don't show 'Rotate' button to viewers without rotate perms. Also gate 'Rotate and copy' so users without `secrets:write` can't retrieve secret; show tooltip 'Contact admin to rotate secrets' if they try.
ryan: Accessibility: rotate modal must trap focus, set role='dialog', and focus first actionable element (primary CTA). After rotating and showing the secret, focus should move to the secret container and announce via aria-live='polite' that the secret is ready and that it will not be shown again. The 'Copy' button must be reachable by keyboard.
a11y-bot: Recommend adding visually-hidden text when modal opens: 'Rotating will replace the secret and the new secret will be visible once. Use a secure manager to store it.' Also ensure the masked preview has aria-label 'Masked secret ending with xYz'.
claire: UX for 'Rotate & revoke old' vs 'Rotate in-place': propose two tabs in the rotate modal: 'Replace secret (same key id)' and 'Create new key (new id)'. Brief bullets under each explaining tradeoffs. Keep the rotate-in-place as default for single-key flows.
omar: Toast copy after rotate: 'Secret rotated. New secret shown. Old secret will stop working in 5 minutes.' Toast should persist for 10s and include 'Download secret' link if user didn't copy. For users without copy perms, toast text: 'Secret rotated. Only admins can view the secret. Download from Secrets store.'
jess: Edge cases: rotating while key is used in running jobs. We should show a warning in the modal: 'This key is used by 3 active jobs. Rotating may cause failures after grace period.' Offer a checklist: 'Notify teams' checkbox that triggers an in-app notification to project members.
ryan: Keyboard shortcuts: Enter to confirm rotate, Escape to cancel, when secret is visible allow Ctrl+C to copy and pressing Enter on copy button should also copy. Provide visible focus outlines for all interactive elements.
claire: Action items: 1) Add rotate tab with clear bullets for in-place vs new key flows; 2) Update modal copy per jess + claire; 3) Build masked preview + accessible Show/Copy affordance per ryan; 4) Add ephemeral options to create modal and the right CTAs; 5) Gate rotate by perms and show helpful tooltip; 6) Toast: 10s, download link, perm-specific messaging. I'll draft a tiny spec and attach annotated mocks. PR/issue link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/523 (draft)
a11y-bot: Also added a short checklist test cases for screen readers to design-qa.https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/780
claire: Thanks team 6 I'll schedule a quick handoff meeting with eng tomorrow to walk through the spec.
